name: Witch Doctor: nuke crit, cast speed and damage spellmods (#955, #1085, #2000, #1049)
contract: Jin'do's Wrath (707505, #955), Dark Magic (705922, #1085), It's Da Voodoo (560278, #2000) and Loa Communion (705907, #1049) are all SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA passives (SpellFamilyName 19) carrying SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER/ADD_PCT_MODIFIER effects whose EffectSpellClassMask already matches their target spell's own SpellFamilyFlags. The stock engine (AuraEffect::CalculateSpellMod, SpellInfo::IsAffected, Player::ApplySpellMod) registers and applies each modifier with no Witch Doctor script needed; this scenario proves the registration and the exact modified value for each, and fails if a future change stops the modifier from matching. Jin'do's Wrath/Dark Magic/It's Da Voodoo target spells that deal their own direct SCHOOL_DAMAGE; Loa Communion's target (Veil of Darkness) forwards through SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA's periodic trigger to VeilDamage (806473), whose own SpellFamilyFlags equal the modifier's class mask, so the metric queries 806473 directly. EffectBasePoints are read from Spell.dbc via coa-dbc-viewer and include the DieSides=1 (+1) roll SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue always applies for a fixed 1..1 die.
